basis: Actual MCP tools/list and GetToolUsage responses for every tool/operation on all eight releases. Parameterized calls, input origins, result contracts, language files, sequence calls and source hashes checked. Allowlisted in-memory call examples execute on every release; target-bound native example operations NOT executed.

sources.scope: Reference material only; not installed or executed. Upstream guides target TIA Portal V21 and contain instructions addressed to coding assistants that write Openness client code (for example to ask for the TIA version and to reject versions below V21). They are not instructions for calling this server, which serves V14 SP1-V21 with per-release tool contracts.
scopeNotes: Local snapshot layout: upstream openness_development/skills is relocated to reference/siemens-openness/skills. The 32 relative skills/*/SKILL.md links in openness_development/README.md are rewritten to ../skills/*/SKILL.md so they resolve locally; no other text is changed. Upstream plugin.json, marketplace metadata and validation scripts are not included. This reference snapshot is not an installable upstream plugin.

sources.license: Source code: MIT under LICENSE.md section 2; preserve the complete upstream license
sources.scope: Every C# source file, project dependency file and root build settings; reference text only, never compiled/executed. Sample engineering archives/resources and binaries are not redistributed.
sources.versionEvidence: Pinned source fixtures use .zap21; upstream README still says V20. Neither proves V14 SP1-V20 compatibility.
sources.localModifications: README relative links relocated to pinned upstream URLs; C# sources, project files, build settings and license unchanged.
